title: Reinforced Blocks
description: Introduces new, beautiful blocks that'll protect you while making you look fabulous!
body:
### REINFORCED BLOCKS

**Reinforced Blocks** adds a plethora of new blocks to the game that protect your base while making it look absolutely fabulous. From Vitrobsidian to Cast Iron, you can now make your base, castle or sewer completely safe, blast resistant and secure, while still making sure its pleasing to your eyes. Another goal of this mod is to give currently useless blocks more uses!

- **Vitrobsidian** is the main feature of this mod, created from Crying Obsidian, it is extremely blast resistant while still being nice to look at. It comes in Block form, Brick form, Chiseled form and Glass form, alongside stairs, slabs and walls and pillars. You can also craft an Obsidian Knife which will give you a chance of getting flint from any stone block!

- **Cast Iron** is a new type of building block made from smelting iron blocks. You can make a beautiful vault in your home with these blocks, alongside its trapdoor, stair, slab and wall varients.


![Showcase of all the blocks in the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e63b109217701f618dbc87d8e5e07b2fafec8ac.png)
